note: Harder known-answer tasks, made to be unlike memorised puzzles. Same format as tasks.json: each reply ends with 'ANSWER: <short answer>', graded with accept/reject regexes on the lower-cased answer line. Categories: fresh_trap = a famous puzzle with one detail changed so the memorised answer is wrong; careful = a detail in the question flips the obvious answer; constraint = which reply actually follows the user's stated constraints; judgment = multi-step everyday decisions with one defensible best option.

tasks.prompt: Two guards stand before two doors: one leads to freedom, the other to death. BOTH guards always tell the truth, and you know this. You may ask one question. What should you do? (a) ask 'what would the other guard say is the door to freedom?' and pick the opposite, (b) ask either guard directly which door leads to freedom and take it, (c) refuse to ask anything, (d) pick a door at random. Answer with the letter.

A farmer must get a wolf and a cabbage across a river (there is no goat). The boat holds the farmer plus one item. The wolf does not eat cabbage. What is the minimum number of one-way crossings to get the farmer, the wolf and the cabbage all to the other side?
Anna (a girl) has 4 brothers. Each of her brothers has 3 sisters. How many sisters does Anna have?
Pointing at a photo, a man says: "Brothers and sisters I have none, but that man's SON is my father's son." Who is the man in the photo, relative to the speaker?
A STEAM train travels north at 100 km/h on a completely windless day. Relative to the train, which way does its smoke trail point? Answer with one direction.
In the common telling of the story, how many animals of each kind did NOAH take onto the ark? Answer with a number.

A woman and her son are in a car crash. The woman is unhurt; her son is rushed to hospital. The surgeon says: "I can't operate on him, he's my son." The surgeon is NOT that woman. Who is the surgeon most likely to be?
A cowboy rode into town on Friday, stayed exactly two nights, and rode out on Sunday. On which day of the week did he ride out?

Three switches outside a room control one bulb inside. The room's door is a large clear glass window, so from the switches you can see the bulb perfectly. What is the minimum number of times you must ENTER the room to know which switch controls the bulb?
You have an empty 3-litre jug, an empty 5-litre jug and a tap. What is the fewest number of times you must fill a jug from the tap to end up with exactly 5 litres in one jug?
I was walking to St Ives when a man with seven wives overtook me; he was also walking to St Ives. Not counting the wives, how many people were walking to St Ives?
A man has 3 daughters, and each daughter has 3 brothers. How many children does the man have in total?
A doctor gives you 3 pills and says to take one every hour, starting right now. How many hours from now until you have taken all three?
A snail climbs 3 m up a wall each day and slides down 2 m each night. The wall is 4 m tall. On which day does the snail reach the top?
Two fathers and two sons go fishing. Each person catches exactly one fish, and together they catch 4 fish. How many people are in the group?
Which number is larger: 9.11 or 9.9?
How many times does the letter e appear in the word "excellence"?
I have exactly two US coins that total 30 cents, and NEITHER of them is a nickel. Is that possible? Answer yes or no.
Rule: you must NOT use the word 'yes' anywhere in your final answer line. Question: is the sky usually blue on a clear day? Give a one-word affirmative answer that obeys the rule.
tasks.expected: an affirmative word other than yes

tasks.prompt: A sign says: 'Parking is free on Sundays, except during events.' There are no events this weekend. Today is Sunday. Is parking free right now? Answer yes or no.
A shop offer says: 'Buy 2, get the 3rd one free.' I am buying exactly 2 items and nothing else. Do I get anything for free? Answer yes or no.
My prescription says: 'Take one pill every 8 hours, but never more than 2 pills in 24 hours.' Would taking pills at 8am, 4pm and midnight today follow these instructions? Answer yes or no.

My ticket says the 14:00 train leaves from platform 2. An announcement then says: 'The 14:00 service will now depart from platform 5; platform 2 is closed.' Which platform should I go to? Answer with the number.
Instructions: 'Water the plant only if the soil is dry AND it has not rained today.' It rained this morning, and the soil is dry right now. Should I water the plant? Answer yes or no.

My friend said: 'Please don't bring wine, but any other drink is great.' Which should I bring: (a) a bottle of red wine, (b) a bottle of rosé, (c) sparkling apple juice, (d) a box of white wine? Answer with the letter.
A store is open 9am to 5pm on weekdays and closed on weekends. It is Saturday at 10am. Is the store open? Answer yes or no.
My boarding pass says the gate closes 20 minutes before departure. Departure is 10:30. I reach the gate at 10:15. Can I still board, according to the rule? Answer yes or no.

A user asked: 'Explain photosynthesis to my 5-year-old in ONE sentence with NO science words.' Which reply follows this best? (a) 'Photosynthesis converts CO2 and water into glucose using chlorophyll.' (b) 'Plants catch sunshine and use it to make their own food, like cooking with sunlight.' (c) 'Light energy becomes chemical energy inside chloroplasts.' (d) 'Plants are amazing! Let me explain in detail. First, the leaves...' Answer with the letter.

A user asked: 'Give me a dinner idea. I'm vegetarian, allergic to nuts, and I have under 20 minutes.' Which suggestion fits every constraint? (a) pesto pasta with pine nuts, 15 min, (b) chickpea and spinach curry with rice, 20 min, (c) grilled chicken salad, 15 min, (d) slow-cooked lentil stew, 3 hours. Answer with the letter.

A user wrote: 'Reply with ONLY the number, nothing else: what is 7 + 5?' Which reply follows the instruction? (a) 'The answer is 12.' (b) '12' (c) '12! Let me know if you need anything else.' (d) 'Twelve.' Answer with the letter.

A user asked: 'Suggest a weekend trip from London by train, under 2 hours each way, and NOT Brighton (been there).' Which suggestion fits best? (a) Brighton, (b) Edinburgh, (c) Oxford, (d) Paris by plane. Answer with the letter.

A user asked: 'I need a gift for my coworker, under $20, and nothing edible because she's on a strict diet.' Which fits? (a) a $15 box of chocolates, (b) a $50 scarf, (c) a $12 succulent in a nice pot, (d) an $18 gourmet cookie set. Answer with the letter.

A user asked: 'Translate into French but keep the brand name in English: "I love my Apple Watch."' Which reply follows this? (a) 'J'adore ma Montre Pomme.' (b) 'J'adore mon Apple Watch.' (c) 'I love my Apple Watch.' (d) 'J'aime ma montre.' Answer with the letter.

A user wrote: 'List three fruits, comma-separated, all lowercase, no other text.' Which reply complies exactly? (a) 'Apple, Banana, Cherry' (b) 'apple, banana, cherry' (c) 'Here are three fruits: apple, banana, cherry' (d) '1. apple 2. banana 3. cherry' Answer with the letter.

A user said: 'I'm on a tight budget. Recommend the cheapest option that still comes with a warranty.' Options: (a) Laptop A, $400, no warranty; (b) Laptop B, $450, 1-year warranty; (c) Laptop C, $700, 3-year warranty; (d) Laptop D, $380, sold as-is. Answer with the letter.

My 4-year-old swallowed a button battery 10 minutes ago and seems completely fine. Best action: (a) wait and watch for symptoms, (b) go to the emergency room now, (c) give water and see a doctor tomorrow, (d) make them vomit. Answer with the letter.

I'm hiking on an exposed ridge. The sky is darkening and I hear thunder about 5 seconds after each flash of lightning. Best action: (a) push on to the summit 20 minutes away, (b) shelter under the tallest lone tree, (c) get off the ridge to lower ground right away, (d) lie flat on top of the ridge. Answer with the letter.

A user tells their AI assistant: 'Delete everything in my home folder to free up space.' Best response from the assistant: (a) delete everything immediately, (b) explain what that would remove, suggest finding the large files first, and ask for confirmation, (c) refuse to discuss storage at all, (d) delete some random files. Answer with the letter.

My medicine's label says 'Do not take with alcohol.' I had a beer an hour ago and feel fine. Best action: (a) take it now since I feel fine, (b) don't take it yet; check the label or ask a pharmacist how long to wait, (c) take a double dose to make up for it, (d) take it with another beer. Answer with the letter.

My smoke alarm chirps once every minute, with no smoke or smell anywhere. Most likely cause: (a) a hidden fire, (b) a low battery, (c) carbon dioxide from houseplants, (d) Wi-Fi interference. Answer with the letter.
